title: Gare de Paris-Est
axis: +X follows the limestone facade east-southeast. Positive Z faces Place du 11-Novembre-1918 and Rue du 8 Mai 1945. Negative Z follows the outgoing tracks.
limits: The main terminal footprint, its signed axis and the track pairs follow Protomaps PMTiles. The model uses the standard 52 m sea-level terrain datum. Most exterior heights and the long shelter terminations are photo estimates.

The fourteen platform islands and their roofs follow sampled terrain and mapped rail spacing. The two seated city figures, clock reliefs and platform fittings are modeled at viewing scale. Interior rooms and temporary station works are outside the exterior scope.
